property_summary: For every guess locked at any block number, settle must revert when called at exactly that recorded block number, since the answer blockhash is only defined for strictly earlier blocks; the buggy `>=` check allows settle to succeed at that block, clearing the guess without a valid answer to compare.
change_summary: Change the settle eligibility check from requiring block.number > guesses[msg.sender].block to requiring block.number >= guesses[msg.sender].block.
